rename.from: [bug] Tauri 2: XCode bundle Identifier does not use tauri.conf.json
rename.to: [bug] Tauri 2: iOS app's bundle identifier does not use tauri.conf.json

body:
I think it would make sense to use `identifier` in `tauri.config.json` as the PackageName in Android and BundleId in iOS.

Is there any story as to why we are combining the name from Cargo.toml and tauri.config.json? cc @lucasfernog
it's a tech debt from cargo-mobile.. we should fix this
I'll try to fix it then.
updated the diff with a small cleanup - i needed to update my macOS :D

issue.title: refactor!: use config.domain as package name and bundle id
issue.body:
<!--
Before submitting a PR, please read https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/blob/dev/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-request-guidelines

1. Give the PR a descriptive title.

  Examples of good title:
    - fix(android): fix emulator detection
    - docs: update docstrings
    - feat: add new mobile template

  Examples of bad title:
    - fix #7123
    - update docs
    - fix bugs

2. If there is a related issue, reference it in the PR text, e.g. closes #123.
3. If this change requires a new version, then add a change file in `.changes` directory with the appropriate bump, see https://github.com/tauri-apps/cargo-mobile2/blob/dev/.changes/readme.md
4. Ensure that all your commits are signed https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/managing-commit-signature-verification/signing-commits
5. Ensure `cargo test` passes.
6. Open as a draft PR if your work is still in progress.
-->

Ref: https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/issues/9851

**BREAKING CHANGE:**
Will use `config.domain` as `Package Name` in Android and `BundleId` in iOS.
Before: `config.domain` + libname in Cargo.toml

If we are going to change the behavior, maybe changing the variable `domain` to `identifier` will be better?
